original_v2_bridge.scope: NativeBF16/medium with unchanged init and random/input streams. Update trajectories are close but not bitwise identical; this test does not establish the exact numerical source of that drift.

limits: Original 500..2500 checkpoints and latent code matrices are absent from the inspected run roots. Scalar variance cannot reconstruct directional rank.
v2 geometry records only actual B4 before updates0,1. Their inputs differ; B4 covariance rank cannot exceed3 regardless of representation.
Preflight validation uses8 fixed rows; original full-run validation uses512. Do not interpret their variance difference as a matched learning curve.
First established small-variation fixed512 observation is update500 in all4arms. Collapse onset update and rank trajectory remain unknown.
Causal v2 six-update cases validate mechanisms and data matching, not long-term causal performance.
Official_init loads439 released encoder/VAE/image-decoder tensors with fresh local16D g and optimizer; it is not a released optimizer or state-head replay.
No existing continuation, model, optimizer, or training script was changed. No GPU or training used.
